ModMetaData.author: Rick, SirMashedPotato
ModMetaData.name: ESCP - Sloads
ModMetaData.description: The Elder Scrolls Collaboration Project Presents: Sloads, the slug-like necromancers of Thras. Based on the original ESCP Sload by SirMashedPotato, rebuilt to run without Humanoid Alien Races.\n\nSloads are slow, huge and terrible at almost every kind of work, but they make fine researchers and can raise fresh corpses as thralls. Their kingdom trades in Sload soap and, when it is crossed, in the Thrassian Plague.
